passage: Repair cafes invite residents to bring broken household items and work with volunteers. Success is sometimes reported as the number of visitors, but organisers increasingly track several outcomes. An item may be repaired during the session, diagnosed for a later professional repair, or judged unsafe to use. Even an unsuccessful repair can teach an owner how a product failed. Clear categories prevent organisers from describing every examined object as waste avoided and make comparisons between events more meaningful.
